newsitem.title: USA: SDL signs contract with Corning.
newsitem.headline: SDL signs contract with Corning.

text.p: SDL Inc Monday signed a multi-million dollar contract to supply Corning Inc with modules used in optical fiber amplifiers.
SDL characterized the agreement as a "multi-million dollar contract" in a written statement, but further financial details were not disclosed.

Optical amplifiers are used in fiber optic transmission systems to increase signal power and reduce the need for electronic repeaters. Optical amplifiers are a critical technology for high bandwidth communication networks.
